concerns.text: FR-007 (6-hour execution limit) and SC-004 (timing measurement) lack a complete task chain. T016 is marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`) and explicitly requires generating `data/results/timing_evidence.json`. Without this task's completion, the spec's mandatory execution constraint cannot be verified or measured.

FR-003 (Benjamini-Hochberg correction) and FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) are blocked. T025 (FDR correction) and T030 (Sensitivity Analysis) are marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). T025 is the sole producer of `data/results/correlation_matrix.json`, which T030 and T031 depend on. The pipeline cannot satisfy FR-003 or FR-005 without these tasks.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) for synthetic data is unaddressed. T006d (Define `synthetic_data_manifest_schema.yaml`) is marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). The Analyze report confirms the schema is missing, preventing verification of synthetic data reproducibility and invalidating downstream tasks T006e and T006c.

FR-006 (Collinearity Diagnostics) is incomplete. T021h (Dynamic Multicollinearity detection via matrix rank check) is marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). T031 (VIF calculation) depends on T021h to skip VIF for perfectly collinear pairs. Without T021h, the system cannot correctly handle linearly dependent predictors as required by FR-006.

FR-007 (Compute constraints) and Assumption-001 (RAM limits) lack implementation. T058 (RAM Pre-check), T059 (Streaming), and T060 (RAM Fail-fast) are all marked unimplemented (`- [ ]`). The plan explicitly requires these to handle large datasets and enforce the 6-hour/7GB constraints, yet no tasks exist to implement the logic.

Duplicate section header 'Phase N+7: Review Resolution & Final Validation' appears twice in the document (once before T072a and again at the very end). This is a formatting error that may confuse the execution order or task grouping.
